Subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff: VeloxAI — documents & PO routing

Hi Bethany —

Thanks for engaging with Redwood. We're kicking off vendor setup so our finance and procurement teams can route POs and start payments. Below is a short intake checklist and the items we need to enable PO matching and set up ACH/wire. I attached the vendor onboarding checklist and buyer intake form for convenience.

Quick checklist (what we need from you):
- Legal business name and DBA (as it should appear on invoices)
- Registered address and mailing address (if different)
- Tax identifier: EIN for US entities (or VAT/GST for non-US) — W-9 or equivalent
- Remit-to details for ACH and wire: bank name, account holder, last 4 digits of account, routing/IBAN format (do NOT send full account numbers in email if you prefer)
- AP contact: name, email, phone for invoice submission and PO matching
- Sample invoice (PDF) showing how VeloxAI wants the PO number referenced
- Bank letter or voided check for ACH verification (attachment stub is fine)

Redwood PO notes:
- Our system requires a PO number on each invoice. The PO can be placed in the invoice number field or in the invoice header labelled "PO" — either works but be consistent.
- If you need a specific remit-to email for PO matching (e.g., invoices@veloxai.com), please provide it.
- We support e-invoicing integrations (Coupa/Ariba) — let us know if you'd like to set that up.

Timeline: if you can send the items above within 3 business days we should be able to complete onboarding and issue the first PO within this billing cycle.

Attachments (referenced): redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf, redwood_buyer_intake_form.xlsx

Thanks — look forward to your info.

Best,
Avery Johnson
